title: AXF project manifest (project-manifest@1)
description: Generated from framework/schemas/project-rules.json. Errors here are hints; the rules are what the build engine enforces.

$manifest.description: The file says which format it is: "$manifest": "project-manifest@1".

name.description: Lowercase letters, digits and dashes, starting with a letter or digit, up to 63 characters. It is the project's folder on the hub (/projects/<name>), so it never changes lightly.

kind.description: What the project is: one of the kind vocabulary.

status.description: active, planned, dormant or archived (active when left out).

relation.description: framework.relation: core (the framework itself), built-on (an AXF app or library), for (made to work with AXF) or none.

appManifest.description: framework.appManifest, when given, points at the app's axf.manifest.json.

owner.description: repo.owner: the GitHub (or other host) account, e.g. MossesX.

name.description: repo.name: the project's own repository name. Required even when the repo doesn't exist yet, so it can be created with that name later.

exists.description: repo.exists: true when the repository has been created, false when it is only reserved for the future.

host.description: repo.host: github, gitlab, bitbucket or other (github when left out).

url.description: repo.url, when given, is an https address.

location.description: When the project has no repo of its own yet, location says where its code is now (location.repo + location.path).

version.description: version, when given, is semver (1.2.3, optionally -pre).

platforms.description: platforms lists where it runs, from the platform vocabulary.

created.description: created, when given, is a date: YYYY-MM-DD.

shared.description: data.shared lists the project's shared data as paths inside the project (folders end with /). They sync with /projects/<name>/_data/<same path>.
